name: Mion Kirara
source:
"Let's go shopping together on the weekend! Ok♪"

The protagonist's cross-dressing childhood friend
From Earth.

A boy who loves cute things. The protagonist's best friend since childhood. 
His cheerfulness always brings a smile to the faces of those around him.
A reassuring ally.
